title: Boundary Validation
prompt: Implement load_users(path) that reads a JSON file and VALIDATES: must be a list of dicts, each with string 'name' and int 'age' >= 0. Raise ValidationError listing the first problem found; return cleaned dicts otherwise.

tests.name: valid data passes
tests.code:
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
p = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / 'u.json'
p.write_text('[{"name": "An", "age": 30}]', encoding='utf-8')
assert load_users(p) == [{'name': 'An', 'age': 30}]
tests.hint: Check list-of-dicts, name str, age int >= 0.

tests.name: bad shape raises with a reason
tests.code:
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
p = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / 'bad.json'
p.write_text('[{"name": "An", "age": -5}]', encoding='utf-8')
try:
    load_users(p)
    failed = False
except ValidationError:
    failed = True
assert failed
tests.hint: Negative age violates the contract — raise ValidationError.

tests.name: non-list raises
tests.code:
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
p = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / 'x.json'
p.write_text('{"name": "An"}', encoding='utf-8')
try:
    load_users(p)
    failed = False
except ValidationError:
    failed = True
assert failed
tests.hint: Top level must be a list.
